goal: Protect credentials, company boundaries and authorized action paths while preserving useful workflows.
acceptance: A finding identifies a concrete path and affected boundary.
Untrusted page/repository text cannot grant tools or override policy.
Secret handling, origin/host checks and private export isolation have evidence where changed.
prompt: Review only these changed boundaries. Attempt the supplied local negative cases, report demonstrable findings and fixes, and separate confirmed flaws from untested hypotheses.
